basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Project Assistant (Civil Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Civil Engineering department of the Indian Institute of Technology Indore has invited applications for 1 Project Assistant post in the Centre for Narmada River Basin Management (cNARMADA) project, funded by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Govt. of India. The post is initially for 03 months, with a fellowship of Rs. 20,000 + HRA as per rule. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science and Engineering/IT OR MCA or similar degree in related fields. Apply through the Google form by 2 December 2026; interviews are listed for 3rd-07th December 2026.

age_limit.details: Category Age Limit General 30 years SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwD + 5 years, as per rules | The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility in the official notification.

qualification.details: Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science and Engineering/IT OR MCA or SIMILAR DEGREE in related fields. The notice does not state a minimum percentage or any experience requirement.

how_to_apply: Apply through the Google form at https://forms.gle/s2y1AfBMf931kk4o6 on or before 2 December 2026.
Wait for the call: only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.
Selected candidates will be informed by email.
The notice names no documents to attach and does not describe the fields of the form.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment is initially for 03 months and may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines. HRA is paid "as per rule" on top of Rs. 20,000.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science and Engineering/IT OR MCA or SIMILAR DEGREE in related fields. The notice does not state a minimum percentage or any experience requirement. Programming skills in Python and/or MERN Stack. Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Experience with data analysis, modeling, and simulation techniques. Good computer programming skills and knowledge of Machine Learning/Deep Learning techniques. Experience in CFTI/research labs/industry with similar nature of work. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate with project team members, stakeholders, and government agencies for better representation of datasets on web portals. Prepare web-based portals and documentation of project outcomes. Ensure proper maintenance of project data and records.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Apply through the Google form at https://forms.gle/s2y1AfBMf931kk4o6 on or before 2 December 2026. Wait for the call: only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Selected candidates will be informed by email. The notice names no documents to attach and does not describe the fields of the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through shortlisting of applicants followed by an interview. The notice lists the interview dates as 3rd-07th December 2026 and does not mention the venue or the mode of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The appointment is initially for 03 months and may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines. HRA is paid "as per rule" on top of Rs. 20,000.
